answer: Deposits are visible in trellis, and voyage reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 149 aliases, and each one needs its own funded basalt account. A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 345 aliases cost 258 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
